thread:
ravi (Finance): Quick update: rolling billing changes go live June 10, 2026. Key items: a rolling burst pool for hosted accounts, softer auto-overage throttles, and more granular invoices (model + region + token-type). Details: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/rolling-burst-2026 :loud_sound:

jun (Eng): Can you define "rolling burst pool" in one line?

ravi (Finance): Its a small, continuously-refilling token allowance per account that absorbs short spikes. Its predictable and visible in the console. When its empty we move to a soft throttle with queued retries for best-effort requests.

emily (Sales): Enterprise/Dedicated: unaffected?

ravi (Finance): Contracted customers keep current behavior unless they opt in. This mainly affects self-serve hosted customers.

billing-bot: NEW SAMPLE: https://billing.redwood.internal/samples/itemized-compact-2026.pdf (example invoice lines: model, region, prompt/completion tokens, burst usage) :page_facing_up:

kate (Customer Success): What about the free trial credit?

ravi (Finance): Trial credit for new signups will change from 50k tokens to 25k tokens starting June 10. Existing trialers created before the 10th get a 45-day grandfather window at 50k and will receive an email + console banner.

sasha (Prod Ops): Could the soft throttles surface as 429s for low-latency customers?

ravi (Finance): We engineered a staged rollout: (1) opt-in beta Apr 15, (2) global rollout Jun 10 with a 14-day "queue-first" grace period where we queue rather than throttle, (3) post-grace enforce soft throttles + backoff guidance. CS can request whitelists for critical customers during migration.

max (Support): If a customer is impacted during rollout, what's the compensation plan?

ravi (Finance): Auto-credits for outages caused by the migration (criteria: sustained degraded requests >= 45 minutes). CS has a dispute fast-path. Well publish reconciliation CSVs and a public FAQ.

jun (Eng): Any SDK changes we need to push?

ravi (Finance): Minor SDK patch with recommended retry/backoff presets and a header X-Redwood-Billing-Debug to simulate exhaustion in staging. Please prioritize.

emily (Sales): New invoice granularity helps channel partners for chargeback. Anything else for sales teams?

ravi (Finance): We'll release a one-pager for pricing conversations and a new optional "burst add-on" SKU for customers who want larger instant pools without changing committed capacity.

sasha (Prod Ops): I'll add dashboards: per-account burst remaining, exhaustion rate, 429/queue events.

kate (Customer Success): Action items for CS: send targeted emails, update KB, prepare migration playbook, and generate impacted-account CSV. I'll sync with ops tomorrow.

ravi (Finance): Thanks all. For questions or to request whitelisting during rollout, file in #billing-requests or email finance@redwood.com. Exec signoff by Ravinder (CFO). :white_check_mark:
